regime_context: As of 2026-08-13, the US thematic detector shows a broad rotation (41/49 eligible) with no one-narrative dominance (absorption 0.33): Memory/HBM is top-ranked but has low breadth/durability and a fading val_state, while Cybersecurity is the crowded challenger. The absolute-trend gate has helped historically, but relative-momentum rank-IC is ~0 and the 22-call track record has weak directional accuracy, so all leans are low-conviction and conditional.
emerging_watch: Cybersecurity is the challenger to Memory/HBM; watch whether it completes a confirmed leadership handoff: cybersecurity durability_bar remains at least 0.8 and breadth stays at 1.0 for 5 consecutive sessions while Memory/HBM durability_bar stays at or below 0.51. If that condition does not hold, drop the watch.

theses.subject: Cybersecurity
theses.thesis: Cybersecurity is trend-healthy by the detector's strongest leg: trend-gate eligible, durability_bar 0.91, hurst_tag trend, and breadth 1.0. The crowding_z 2.13 is a size-down caution, not a fade; with the absolute-trend discipline validated in this market, a positive direction is conditional on that trend health holding.
theses.dissent: Crowding is extended and rank-IC ~0 means leadership is attention, not alpha; crowded thematic ETFs can top and mean-revert even if the trend gate still reads eligible.

falsifier.text: CIBR trails SPY by 5% or cybersecurity durability_bar falls below 0.70 before the check-by date.

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Gold miners is a non-tech trend with clean internal structure: trend-gate eligible, durability_bar 0.80, hurst_tag trend, breadth 1.0, and crowding_z -0.05. The absolute-trend gate is the validated edge here; this lean is a trend-continuation judgment, not a momentum-rank call.
theses.dissent: Gold miners can be driven by real yields and risk appetite, not thematic flow; the rotation signal has no validated forward edge and may whipsaw.

falsifier.text: GDX lags SPY by 5% or its trend-gate eligibility turns false before the check-by date.

theses.subject: Memory, HBM & Storage
theses.thesis: The top rank is a focus lens, not a buy. Memory/HBM has weak internal trend health for a leader: durability_bar 0.51, breadth 0.25, hurst_tag mixed, and val_state fading, despite eligible=true. This is a de-risking underweight of a fragile leader, not a fade call on crowding because it is not crowded.
theses.dissent: The leader could remain reflexive; HBM/storage fundamentals or supply-demand news could re-ignite broad participation, and underweighting the top-ranked theme simply on weak breadth has a documented leader-fade failure mode.

falsifier.text: SMH proxy's breadth recovers above 0.60 and durability_bar rises above 0.70 before the check-by date while the theme remains rank 1.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
